description: A Spaces sidebar with cards or a list: an icon, a color and a note for each space, pinned spaces on top, the agents, tabs and git status of each space, its terminals with their status, and recent spaces to open again.

settings.label: View
settings.hint: Cards show the details of each space. The list shows one row for each space. The button in the panel header does the same.

settings.label: Terminals
settings.hint: Which spaces show their terminals under the space at first. The terminal button of a space shows or hides them.

settings.label: Card: agents
settings.hint: Show the agents of the space and their status on the card.

settings.label: Card: tabs and terminals
settings.hint: Show how many tabs and terminals the space has.

settings.label: Card: git
settings.hint: Show the branch, ahead and behind, and the changed files.

settings.label: Card: folder and machine
settings.hint: Show the folder where the space works and the machine of a remote space.

settings.label: Card: last activity
settings.hint: Show when an agent of the space changed status, or when you selected the space, for the last time.

settings.label: Card: note
settings.hint: Show the note of the space.

settings.label: Git refresh
settings.hint: How often the panel reads the git status of each space. It also reads it when an agent of the space changes status.

settings.label: Needs you first
settings.hint: Put the spaces with an agent that needs you (blocked or done) at the top of their section.

settings.label: Recent spaces
settings.hint: How many closed spaces the Recent section shows. 0 hides the section.
